From 477f4cee16e9961ed0d96e82cc12aa8633bf9110 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: A Developer <dev@example.org>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2024 12:00:00 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] foo: fix default sample rate

1 kHz to avoid aliasing. Raise the default to 1000.

@@ -1 +1 @@

+static int rate = 1000;
